columns.caption: First rows of the file — choose what each column is

basis.surface: We found the elevation from the points themselves: in this order no position has two elevations. Change it if the file says otherwise.
basis.magnitude: We found the elevation from the size of the values: they are far smaller than the coordinates. Change the order if the file says otherwise.
basis.file-order: The file has no header and the data do not reveal the order — we kept the file's order. Check the columns before you continue.

preset.PNEZD: PNEZD — No., Northing(Y), Easting(X), Elev., Description
preset.PENZD: PENZD — No., Easting(X), Northing(Y), Elev., Description

unit.label: File units
unit.declared: The drawing declares its units — nothing to choose.

suggested.greek-grid: We suggested “{unit}”: the coordinates fall inside the Greek grid (EGSA '87). Change it if the file says otherwise.
suggested.extent: We suggested “{unit}” from the size of the survey. Change it if the file says otherwise.

unit.needed: We could not tell the file's units — choose them so the terrain can be computed.

file.typesHint: CSV, TXT, XYZ, Excel (.xlsx) or DXF with points and elevations

refusals.xls-legacy: This is an old Excel file (.xls), which cannot be read safely. Open it in Excel and save it as “Excel Workbook (.xlsx)” or as CSV.
refusals.dxf-binary: This DXF is saved in binary form. Save it again from your CAD program as a text (ASCII) DXF.
refusals.dwg: This is an AutoCAD drawing (.dwg), which we cannot read yet. Open it in your CAD program and save it as DXF (“Save As” → DXF), or ask the surveyor for the DXF.
refusals.pdf: This PDF is the surveyor’s printed drawing, not a file of points with elevations. For the plot outline, upload it in the "Topographic plan" tab; for the relief, ask the surveyor for the survey points as CSV, TXT, Excel or DXF.
refusals.unsupported: This file format is not a survey we can read. Upload CSV, TXT, XYZ, Excel (.xlsx) or DXF.
refusals.unreadable: The file could not be read — it may be damaged or locked by another program. Close it there and try again.
refusals.empty: The file has no points. Check that you chose the survey file and not another drawing or sheet.

points.summary: {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} · {withElevation} with elevation
points.noPosition: Choose which columns are X and Y — without them there are no points.
points.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row that is not a point was skipped} other {# rows that are not points were skipped}}: {rows}
points.coincident: {count, plural, one {# position was measured twice with the same elevation — one was kept} other {# positions were measured twice with the same elevation — one was kept}}
points.conflicting: {count, plural, one {# position has two different elevations — marked on the map; check it with the surveyor} other {# positions have two different elevations — marked on the map; check them with the surveyor}}

buyer.heading: What buyers will see
buyer.intro: The same figures that will be published, from the same computation. Your points and your file are never published — only the map and the statistics.

declaration.surveyorNameHint: As it will appear on the listing as the source of the survey.
declaration.surveyedOnHint: The day of the field measurement, not of drafting or sending.
declaration.rights: I have the right to publish this survey (I made it or I have its author's permission).
declaration.rightsHint: The declaration is kept with the survey. Only the map and the statistics are published, with the surveyor and the date as their source.

listing.published: The terrain is published — the listing already shows it.
listing.withdrawn: The survey was saved, but the listing is not published right now; it will show once the listing is published again.
listing.failed: The survey was saved, but the listing has not been updated yet. It will update automatically — no need to send it again.
listing.absent: The survey was saved, but no listing was found to update.
listing.unknown: The survey was saved. We do not know yet whether the listing was updated — check it in a moment.

refusals.TERRAIN_SOURCE_REQUIRED: No survey was sent — choose the file again and retry
refusals.TERRAIN_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: The survey was not sent in the format the server accepts — reload the page and try again
refusals.TERRAIN_SOURCE_EMPTY: The survey arrived empty — check that you chose the right file
refusals.TERRAIN_SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: The survey is larger than {maxMegabytes} MB — thin out the points and try again
refusals.TERRAIN_SOURCE_MALFORMED: The survey data cannot be read or exceeds the limits (up to {maxPoints} points) — check the file and its coordinate columns
refusals.TERRAIN_DECLARATION_INVALID: The declaration is incomplete — fill in the surveyor and the survey date, and confirm you have the right to publish
refusals.TERRAIN_SURVEY_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The survey date is in the future — correct it and try again
refusals.TERRAIN_NOT_LAND: Terrain relief is published only for plots and land parcels
refusals.TERRAIN_INSUFFICIENT_SURFACE: The points do not form a ground surface — at least three points with elevation are needed, not all on one line
refusals.TERRAIN_EMPTY_AFTER_CLIP: No part of the terrain falls inside the plot boundary — check that boundary and points share the same coordinate system
refusals.TERRAIN_TOO_DENSE: The relief comes out above {maxTriangles} triangles — thin out the points and try again
refusals.TERRAIN_PUBLICATION_NOT_CAPABLE: You do not have permission to publish material to listings
refusals.TERRAIN_NO_DOSSIER: This listing has no property dossier to keep the survey in
refusals.TERRAIN_UPLOAD_FAILED: Saving the survey failed on the server — try again
refusals.TERRAIN_DRAWING_REQUIRED: No survey drawing was sent — choose the DXF or PDF file again and retry
refusals.TERRAIN_DRAWING_EMPTY: The survey drawing arrived empty — check that you chose the right file
refusals.TERRAIN_DRAWING_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: The drawing must be a DXF or a PDF — this file is neither
refusals.TERRAIN_DRAWING_DWG: DWG files cannot be read yet — save the drawing as DXF from your CAD program and upload it again
refusals.TERRAIN_DRAWING_TOO_LARGE: The drawing is too large — up to {dxfMaxMegabytes} MB for DXF and {pdfMaxMegabytes} MB for PDF
refusals.TERRAIN_DRAWING_UNIT_REQUIRED: The DXF declares no length unit — choose whether its coordinates are in metres, millimetres or feet
refusals.TERRAIN_DRAWING_UNREADABLE: No outline was found in the drawing — the DXF has no closed polyline or the PDF has no readable coordinate table
refusals.TERRAIN_PLOT_OUTLINE_INVALID: The outline choice is not valid — pick the outline in the drawing again and confirm
refusals.TERRAIN_PLOT_OUTLINE_NOT_IN_DRAWING: The outline you confirmed was not found in the drawing that was sent — reload the drawing and choose again
refusals.TERRAIN_PLOT_OUTLINE_DISJOINT: The outline does not fall anywhere on the relief — the drawing and the contours use a different coordinate system or a different area
refusals.TERRAIN_PLOT_OUTLINE_UNREADABLE: The dossier's confirmed outline could not be read — nothing was published; try again shortly
refusals.TERRAIN_CURRENT_SOURCE_UNREADABLE: The relief already published could not be read — nothing changed; try again shortly
refusals.TERRAIN_PLOT_OUTLINE_AMENDMENT_INVALID: The outline change is not valid — reload the page and try again
refusals.TERRAIN_PLOT_OUTLINE_NO_RELIEF: No relief has been published yet — the outline will apply when you upload the contours
refusals.TERRAIN_PLOT_OUTLINE_NONE: The relief has no plot outline — confirm one from the survey drawing first
refusals.TERRAIN_GEOREFERENCE_NO_RELIEF: No relief has been published yet — upload the contours first
refusals.TERRAIN_GEOREFERENCE_OUTSIDE_AREA_OF_USE: The survey coordinates fall outside the area of the Greek Grid (GGRS87) — they cannot be declared as Greek Grid
refusals.TERRAIN_GEOREFERENCE_FAR_FROM_LISTING: Read as Greek Grid (GGRS87), the survey falls far from the position the listing declares — check the coordinate system or the listing's position
refusals.TERRAIN_GEOREFERENCE_LISTING_POSITION_UN: The listing declares no position, so the survey cannot be cross-checked — declare the property's position on the listing first
refusals.TERRAIN_GEOREFERENCE_NOT_DECLARED: Declare first that the coordinates are Greek Grid (GGRS87) — without a system there is no position to show
refusals.network: We do not know whether the upload arrived — check your connection and press again; it will not be published twice.
refusals.rejected: The server refused the survey for a reason we do not recognise — try again or contact us.

publish.unavailable: To publish a survey, the listing needs a property dossier in your account, where the file is kept.

current.heading: Published now
current.none: The listing has no terrain relief yet. Upload the plot's survey — buyers will see the elevation difference, slopes and a contour map.
current.replaceHint: A new survey replaces the published one.

plotOutline.intro: Upload the topographic plan (DXF or PDF). Only the plot outline passes from the plan into the relief; the plan itself stays private in your dossier and is never published.

file.typesHint: Topographic plan as DXF or PDF

refusals.dwg: This is an AutoCAD drawing (.dwg), which we cannot read yet. Open it in your CAD program and save it as DXF ("Save as" → DXF), or ask the surveyor for the DXF.
refusals.unsupported: This is not a topographic plan we can read. Upload the plan as DXF or PDF.
refusals.too-large: The plan is larger than we accept (DXF up to {dxfMaxMegabytes} MB, PDF up to {pdfMaxMegabytes} MB).
refusals.unreadable: The plan could not be read — it may be damaged or password-protected. Ask the surveyor for a fresh copy.

unit.needed: The DXF does not declare its units. Choose the units it was drawn in, so areas are measured correctly.

pdf.noTable: No corner coordinate table in EGSA '87 was found in the PDF. The plan is shown, but it gives no outline: we do not guess a position from a picture. Ask the surveyor for the DXF or the coordinate table.
pdf.unreadable: The PDF has no readable text (it is probably scanned). Ask the surveyor for the DXF or a PDF with a coordinate table.
pdf.tableBand: The coordinate table was read here
pdf.noOverlay: The PDF is not georeferenced, so the outline is not placed on the page; it is shown alongside, drawn from the table's coordinates.

candidates.heading: Which one is the plot outline?
candidates.count: {count, plural, one {Found # closed line that may be the plot.} other {Found # closed lines that may be the plot.}}
candidates.none: No closed line was found that could be the plot outline.

noProposal.tie: Two or more candidates have the same evidence — choose the right one yourself.
noProposal.no-evidence: No candidate has evidence in its favour — choose the right one yourself.
noProposal.no-candidates: There is no candidate to choose.

candidates.rejected: {count, plural, one {# closed line was ignored} other {# closed lines were ignored}} (self-intersecting, zero area or too many corners).

areaVs.drawing: {declared} m² written on the plan · {difference}% difference
areaVs.none: no declared area to compare with

evidence.reliefPending: judged on confirmation, against the relief you have published
evidence.cornersLabelled: {labelled} of {corners} corners are labelled (A, B, C…)

view.label: The plan with the candidate outlines
view.ringLabel: The outline from the coordinate table

corroboration.agrees: The area written on the plan ({area} m²) agrees with the coordinates.
corroboration.disagrees: The area written on the plan ({area} m²) does NOT agree with the coordinates — check the table.
corroboration.absent: The plan writes no area to cross-check.
corroboration.sides: {agreeing} of the {printed} side lengths the table prints agree with the coordinates.

showInListing.label: Show the outline in the public listing
showInListing.hint: The plot's shape locates the property on the Land Registry map. If you leave this unticked, only you see the outline.

confirm.needSelection: First choose which one is the plot outline.

confirmed.withRelief: The outline ({area} m²) was confirmed and added to the relief.
confirmed.partial: The relief covers {percent}% of the outline; the rest is not drawn, because we do not invent elevations.
confirmed.waiting: The outline ({area} m²) was saved and will be added to the relief as soon as you publish contours or points.

status.heading: Plot outline
status.none: No plot outline has been set.
status.waiting: Waiting for the first relief: it will be added as soon as you publish contours or points.

source.trash: From the plan "{name}", which is in the trash. The outline stays until you remove it.
source.orphan: From a plan that is no longer in the dossier. The outline stays until you remove it.

status.removeBody: The outline leaves the relief and the listing. The plan stays in your dossier and you can confirm it again.
status.restoreFailed: The plan could not be restored. Try again.

audience.private: Only you see it like this. On the public listing the relief appears without the outline, until you choose to show it above.
audience.public: This is also how it appears on the public listing.

reading.agrees: Read as Greek Grid (GGRS87), the survey falls {distance} m from the position the listing declares (tolerance {tolerance} m).
reading.far-from-listing: Read as Greek Grid (GGRS87), the survey falls {distance} m from the position the listing declares — beyond the {tolerance} m tolerance. Check the coordinate system or the listing's position.
reading.outside-area-of-use: The survey coordinates fall outside the area of the Greek Grid (GGRS87).
reading.listing-position-unknown: The listing declares no position, so the survey cannot be cross-checked. Declare the property's position on the listing first.

system.question: Which system are the survey coordinates in?
system.local: Local coordinates — no position on the map

suggestion.greekGrid: Every point falls inside the area of the Greek Grid. You confirm it — we do not assume it.
suggestion.local: No point falls inside the area of the Greek Grid — these look like local coordinates.

showLocationInListing.needsGreekGrid: Available once you declare above that the coordinates are in GGRS87 — without a system there is no position to show.
showLocationInListing.label: Show the plot on the listing's map, at its measured position
showLocationInListing.hint: Adds to the public listing the plot's position as the surveyor measured it. If you leave it unticked, only you see the measured position; the position you already declared on the listing does not change.

done.changed: The change was saved and the listing was updated.
